note: Independent rejudgment 2026-11-24 against RFC 7950 Section 7.2.2 (rfc/full/rfc7950.txt): "A submodule MUST only be included by either the module to which it belongs or another submodule that belongs to that module." Verified changes since dcc219072a (047f10cdf9): loader_structure.go::checkStructure now delegates each moduleSource to moduleStructureErrors, which still invokes moduleIncludeErrors(mod) (unchanged) and includedSubmodule (unchanged) to enforce belongs-to ownership and return ErrIncludeBelongsTo. TestRFC7950SubmoduleIncludedOnlyByItsModule (both positive and negative tags) is byte-identical and isolates both clauses in both polarities (module and submodule including foreign submodule s refused naming module b; module including own submodule and submodule including sibling load). Verdict stands: enforced.
